name: Post-Soviet streetwear (gopnik style)
description: Russian working-class and suburban gopnik dress of the 1990s taken to fashion weeks: graphic T-shirts with Cyrillic slogans, cropped jeans, loose sweatpants, sports socks, big-logo sportswear and Adilette slides.

name: Slavic chic (folk-craft revival fashion)
description: Polish and Ukrainian designers reviving embroidery, lace, crochet, hand-knitting and weaving from rural dress in luxury and slow fashion; the term Slavic Chic is credited to Magda Butrym.
